products.description:
Go passwordless with phishing-resistant credentials — FIDO2 keys and Windows Hello

Passwords (and even push-based MFA) are still being phished and bombed. Federal and security-conscious organizations are required to move to phishing-resistant, passwordless authentication. This solution stands up passwordless and phishing-resistant MFA in Microsoft Entra ID — FIDO2 hardware security keys, Windows Hello for Business, and (where applicable) certificate-based authentication — enabled as authentication methods, registered by users, and enforced through Conditional Access authentication strengths so weak methods can no longer get in.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — what phishing-resistant, passwordless authentication is, the Entra ID authentication methods model, FIDO2 security keys vs. Windows Hello for Business vs. certificate-based auth, and Conditional Access authentication strengths.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Entra ID licensing, authentication methods policy, FIDO2 key support/provisioning, registration campaign, Conditional Access) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: enable the authentication methods, provision/register FIDO2 keys and Windows Hello, run a registration campaign, create a phishing-resistant authentication strength, enforce it via Conditional Access, then pilot, validate, and expand.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — auth-methods readiness discovery, per-user passwordless registration validation, a tenant credential-method and coverage report, safe remediation of weak-method users, and a target group builder for the rollout.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

Users signing in passwordless with phishing-resistant credentials — FIDO2 keys and Windows Hello — and weak methods blocked by Conditional Access authentication strengths, proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • FIDO2-Discovery.ps1 — tenant authentication-method policy readiness for passwordless/phishing-resistant MFA
    • FIDO2-Remediation.ps1 — safely flag (and optionally group) users lacking a phishing-resistant method
    • FIDO2-Report.ps1 — tenant credential-method coverage report (Microsoft Graph)
    • FIDO2-Set-RolloutTargeting.ps1 — build the pilot and rollout Entra groups for staged targeting
    • FIDO2-Validation.ps1 — confirm a user has a phishing-resistant authentication method registered

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all five PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
